fullText.simplified:
更重要的人

    观众离得太远，看不清楚马上的人，但是有人认出了白马。
    “那是皇帝的马！皇帝是第一名！”一个观众高兴地说，其他的观众听了，也跟着大声说：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝真厉害！”
    听到的人越来越多，说话的人也越来越多，声音越来越大。
    曹操的助手们站在观众前面。他们骑着马，看得很清楚，他们当然知道现在骑在白马上的人不是皇帝，是曹操。但是他们也跟着观众大声说：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝最厉害！”
    刘备站在中间，看看高兴的观众，又看看大笑的曹操。他突然明白了，曹操要皇帝和自己来比赛，就是想让皇帝更怕他，也让其他人明白他比皇帝更重要，他才是国家最重要的人。
    但是，国家已经有皇帝了，怎么可以再多一个更重要的人？
    后面站着的那些官员，很多人笑得很大声，只有很少几个人气得红了脸。那些笑得大声的人都是曹操的人，那几个气得红了脸的人虽然很生气，但是一句话也不敢说。
    “我要杀了他。”年轻的皇帝突然说。
    虽然声音还是很小，但刘备听得很清楚。刘备看了看关羽和张飞，看到他们也在看自己，他们也都气得红了脸。
    关羽拿起大刀，要往前走，刘备轻轻对他说了个没有声音的“不”，他才把刀放下。
    刘备明白关羽的意思，但现在不是杀曹操的时候。曹操有这么多助手，他们是杀不了曹操的。如果不小心，被杀的只会是皇帝、两个弟弟和刘备自己。
fullText.traditional:
更重要的人

    觀眾離得太遠，看不清楚馬上的人，但是有人認出了白馬。
    “那是皇帝的馬！皇帝是第一名！”一個觀眾高興地說，其他的觀眾聽了，也跟著大聲說：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝真厲害！”
    聽到的人越來越多，說話的人也越來越多，聲音越來越大。
    曹操的助手們站在觀眾前面。他們騎著馬，看得很清楚，他們當然知道現在騎在白馬上的人不是皇帝，是曹操。但是他們也跟著觀眾大聲說：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝最厲害！”
    劉備站在中間，看看高興的觀眾，又看看大笑的曹操。他突然明白了，曹操要皇帝和自己來比賽，就是想讓皇帝更怕他，也讓其他人明白他比皇帝更重要，他才是國家最重要的人。
    但是，國家已經有皇帝了，怎麼可以再多一個更重要的人？
    後面站著的那些官員，很多人笑得很大聲，只有很少幾個人氣得紅了臉。那些笑得大聲的人都是曹操的人，那幾個氣得紅了臉的人雖然很生氣，但是一句話也不敢說。
    “我要殺了他。”年輕的皇帝突然說。
    雖然聲音還是很小，但劉備聽得很清楚。劉備看了看關羽和張飛，看到他們也在看自己，他們也都氣得紅了臉。
    關羽拿起大刀，要往前走，劉備輕輕對他說了個沒有聲音的“不”，他才把刀放下。
    劉備明白關羽的意思，但現在不是殺曹操的時候。曹操有這麼多助手，他們是殺不了曹操的。如果不小心，被殺的只會是皇帝、兩個弟弟和劉備自己。

sentences.simplified: 观众离得太远，看不清楚马上的人，但是有人认出了白马。
sentences.traditional: 觀眾離得太遠，看不清楚馬上的人，但是有人認出了白馬。
sentences.pinyin: guān zhòng lí de tài yuǎn kàn bu qīng chu mǎ shang de rén dàn shì yǒu rén rèn chū le bái mǎ
sentences.english: The spectators were too far away to see the man on the horse clearly, but some recognized the white horse.

sentences.simplified: “那是皇帝的马！皇帝是第一名！”一个观众高兴地说，
sentences.traditional: “那是皇帝的馬！皇帝是第一名！”一個觀眾高興地說，
sentences.pinyin: nà shì huáng dì de mǎ huáng dì shì dì yī míng yí ge guān zhòng gāo xìng de shuō
sentences.english: “That’s the emperor’s horse! The emperor is first!” one spectator said happily.

sentences.simplified: 其他的观众听了，也跟着大声说：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝真厉害！”
sentences.traditional: 其他的觀眾聽了，也跟著大聲說：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝真厲害！”
sentences.pinyin: qí tā de guān zhòng tīng le yě gēn zhe dà shēng shuō huáng dì shì dì yī míng huáng dì zhēn lì hai
sentences.english: Hearing this, the other spectators also followed loudly, “The emperor is first! The emperor is amazing!”

sentences.simplified: 听到的人越来越多，说话的人也越来越多，声音越来越大。
sentences.traditional: 聽到的人越來越多，說話的人也越來越多，聲音越來越大。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dào de rén yuè lái yuè duō shuō huà de rén yě yuè lái yuè duō shēng yīn yuè lái yuè dà
sentences.english: As more and more people heard, more and more people were speaking, and their voices were getting louder and louder.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的助手们站在观众前面。他们骑着马，看得很清楚，
sentences.traditional: 曹操的助手們站在觀眾前面。他們騎著馬，看得很清楚，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de zhù shǒu men zhàn zài guān zhòng qián miàn tā men qí zhe mǎ kàn de hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s assistants stood in front of the spectators. They were riding on horses and could see clearly.

sentences.simplified: 他们当然知道现在骑在白马上的人不是皇帝，是曹操。
sentences.traditional: 他們當然知道現在騎在白馬上的人不是皇帝，是曹操。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dāng rán zhī dào xiàn zài qí zài bái mǎ shang de rén bú shì huáng dì shì cáo cāo
sentences.english: They knew without a doubt that the man now riding on the white horse was not the emperor but Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 但是他们也跟着观众大声说：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝最厉害！”
sentences.traditional: 但是他們也跟著觀眾大聲說：“皇帝是第一名！皇帝最厲害！”
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā men yě gēn zhe guān zhòng dà shēng shuō huáng dì shì dì yī míng huáng dì zuì lì hai
sentences.english: But they also said loudly along with the spectators, “The emperor is first! The emperor is the best!”

sentences.simplified: 刘备站在中间，看看高兴的观众，又看看大笑的曹操。
sentences.traditional: 劉備站在中間，看看高興的觀眾，又看看大笑的曹操。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi zhàn zài zhōng jiān kàn kan gāo xìng de guān zhòng yòu kàn kan dà xiào de cáo cāo
sentences.english: Liu Bei stood in the middle, looking at the happy spectators, then looking at the laughing Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 他突然明白了，曹操要皇帝和自己来比赛，
sentences.traditional: 他突然明白了，曹操要皇帝和自己來比賽，
sentences.pinyin: tā tū rán míng bai le cáo cāo yào huáng dì hé zì jǐ lái bǐ sài
sentences.english: He suddenly understood that Cao Cao wanted the emperor to compete with him ..

sentences.simplified: 就是想让皇帝更怕他，
sentences.traditional: 就是想讓皇帝更怕他，
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì xiǎng ràng huáng dì gèng pà tā
sentences.english: .. just to make the emperor more afraid of him ..

sentences.simplified: 也让其他人明白他比皇帝更重要，
sentences.traditional: 也讓其他人明白他比皇帝更重要，
sentences.pinyin: yě ràng qí tā rén míng bai tā bǐ huáng dì gèng zhòng yào
sentences.english: .. and to make other people understand that he was more important than the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 他才是国家最重要的人。
sentences.traditional: 他才是國家最重要的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā cái shì guó jiā zuì zhòng yào de rén
sentences.english: It was he who was the most important person in the country.

sentences.simplified: 但是，国家已经有皇帝了，怎么可以再多一个更重要的人？
sentences.traditional: 但是，國家已經有皇帝了，怎麼可以再多一個更重要的人？
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì guó jiā yǐ jīng yǒu huáng dì le zěn me kě yǐ zài duō yí ge gèng zhòng yào de rén
sentences.english: But the country already had an emperor. How could there be someone more important?

sentences.simplified: 后面站着的那些官员，很多人笑得很大声，只有很少几个人气得红了脸。
sentences.traditional: 後面站著的那些官員，很多人笑得很大聲，只有很少幾個人氣得紅了臉。
sentences.pinyin: hòu miàn zhàn zhe de nà xiē guān yuán hěn duō rén xiào de hěn dà shēng zhǐ yǒu hěn shǎo jǐ ge rén qì de hóng le liǎn
sentences.english: Many of the officials standing in the back laughed loudly, and only a very few turned red with anger.

sentences.simplified: 那些笑得大声的人都是曹操的人，
sentences.traditional: 那些笑得大聲的人都是曹操的人，
sentences.pinyin: nà xiē xiào de dà shēng de rén dōu shì cáo cāo de rén
sentences.english: Those who laughed loudly were all Cao Cao’s men.

sentences.simplified: 那几个气得红了脸的人虽然很生气，但是一句话也不敢说。
sentences.traditional: 那幾個氣得紅了臉的人雖然很生氣，但是一句話也不敢說。
sentences.pinyin: nà jǐ ge qì de hóng le liǎn de rén suī rán hěn shēng qì dàn shì yí jù huà yě bù gǎn shuō
sentences.english: Although the few who turned red with anger were angry, they did not dare to say a word.

sentences.simplified: “我要杀了他。”年轻的皇帝突然说。
sentences.traditional: “我要殺了他。”年輕的皇帝突然說。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yào shā le tā nián qīng de huáng dì tū rán shuō
sentences.english: “I’m going to kill him,” the young emperor said suddenly.

sentences.simplified: 虽然声音还是很小，但刘备听得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 雖然聲音還是很小，但劉備聽得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán shēng yīn hái shi hěn xiǎo dàn liú bèi tīng de hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: Although his voice was still very quiet, Liu Bei could hear it clearly.

sentences.simplified: 刘备看了看关羽和张飞，看到他们也在看自己，他们也都气得红了脸。
sentences.traditional: 劉備看了看關羽和張飛，看到他們也在看自己，他們也都氣得紅了臉。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi kàn le kàn guān yǔ hé zhāng fēi kàn dào tā men yě zài kàn zì jǐ tā men yě dōu qì de hóng le liǎn
sentences.english: Liu Bei looked at Guan Yu and Zhang Fei and saw they were also looking at him. They all turned red with anger.

sentences.simplified: 关羽拿起大刀，要往前走，
sentences.traditional: 關羽拿起大刀，要往前走，
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ ná qǐ dà dāo yào wǎng qián zǒu
sentences.english: Guan Yu picked up his sword and was about to move forward.

sentences.simplified: 刘备轻轻对他说了个没有声音的“不”，他才把刀放下。
sentences.traditional: 劉備輕輕對他說了個沒有聲音的“不”，他才把刀放下。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi qīng qīng duì tā shuō le ge méi yǒu shēng yīn de bù tā cái bǎ dāo fàng xià
sentences.english: Only after Liu Bei gently whispered “no” did he put down his sword.

sentences.simplified: 刘备明白关羽的意思，但现在不是杀曹操的时候。
sentences.traditional: 劉備明白關羽的意思，但現在不是殺曹操的時候。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi míng bai guān yǔ de yì si dàn xiàn zài bú shì shā cáo cāo de shí hou
sentences.english: Liu Bei understood what Guan Yu meant, but now was not the time to kill Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 曹操有这么多助手，他们是杀不了曹操的。
sentences.traditional: 曹操有這麼多助手，他們是殺不了曹操的。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yǒu zhè me duō zhù shǒu tā men shì shā bù liǎo cáo cāo de
sentences.english: Cao Cao had so many assistants. They couldn’t kill Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 如果不小心，被杀的只会是皇帝、两个弟弟和刘备自己。
sentences.traditional: 如果不小心，被殺的只會是皇帝、兩個弟弟和劉備自己。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bù xiǎo xīn bèi shā de zhǐ huì shì huáng dì liǎng ge dì di hé liú bèi zì jǐ
sentences.english: If they weren’t careful, the only people killed would be the emperor, the two younger brothers, and Liu Bei himself.

sentence_translations: The Most Important Person
The spectators were too far away to see the man on the horse clearly, but some recognized the white horse.
“That’s the emperor’s horse! The emperor is first!” one spectator said happily.
Hearing this, the other spectators also followed loudly, “The emperor is first! The emperor is amazing!”
As more and more people heard, more and more people were speaking, and their voices were getting louder and louder.
Cao Cao’s assistants stood in front of the spectators. They were riding on horses and could see clearly.
They knew without a doubt that the man now riding on the white horse was not the emperor but Cao Cao.
But they also said loudly along with the spectators, “The emperor is first! The emperor is the best!”
Liu Bei stood in the middle, looking at the happy spectators, then looking at the laughing Cao Cao.
He suddenly understood that Cao Cao wanted the emperor to compete with him ..
.. just to make the emperor more afraid of him ..
.. and to make other people understand that he was more important than the emperor.
It was he who was the most important person in the country.
But the country already had an emperor. How could there be someone more important?
Many of the officials standing in the back laughed loudly, and only a very few turned red with anger.
Those who laughed loudly were all Cao Cao’s men.
Although the few who turned red with anger were angry, they did not dare to say a word.
“I’m going to kill him,” the young emperor said suddenly.
Although his voice was still very quiet, Liu Bei could hear it clearly.
Liu Bei looked at Guan Yu and Zhang Fei and saw they were also looking at him. They all turned red with anger.
Guan Yu picked up his sword and was about to move forward.
Only after Liu Bei gently whispered “no” did he put down his sword.
Liu Bei understood what Guan Yu meant, but now was not the time to kill Cao Cao.
Cao Cao had so many assistants. They couldn’t kill Cao Cao.
If they weren’t careful, the only people killed would be the emperor, the two younger brothers, and Liu Bei himself.
